rows.grounds: dharā (earth) + atas (ablative, from) + atra (here); sandhi-marked compound; cosmological vertical ordering
jala (water) + ādi (beginning, etc.); sequence of worlds/tattvas above earth
syāt (optative, would be) + uttara-uttarataḥ (higher and higher, successively upward); vertical world-measure
kramāt (ablative, by sequence/order); indicates ordered progression
daśadhā (tenfold) + ahaṅkṛta (ego-principle, ahaṅkāra) + antam (up to, ending in); extent of division reaching ego-tattva
dhīḥ (intellect, buddhi) + tasyāḥ (genitive feminine, of that); refers to preceding principle
syāt (optative, would be) + śatadhā (hundredfold); sandhi śc; measure of division
tataḥ (from that, thereafter); continues sequential cosmological progression
